messages.text:
"Make a 2D Soulslike game that focuses more on player skill and loot farming than pay-to-win. I want a small open world where you defeat enemies like wild boars, undead, witches, and many other diverse foes. There should also be bosses in the game, found in dungeons, or small mini-bosses that appear in the environment to challenge the player. Players should be able to choose between different characters, such as an assassin (with two knives as weapons and very agile), or a soldier (heavy armor for more health and damage, but very slow). It should have a medieval style and include some fantasy elements.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
